description: PikeDev/Go2D — GoLang 2D Game Library based on SDL 1.3. This can be used to easily write games using Go (www.golang.org) using SDL 1.3 for hardware-accelerated rendering (OpenGL or DirectX9). This will also be the core engine for the MMORPG "Pokemon Universe"  (https://code.google.com/p/pokemon-universe)
